en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a large Renaissance castle complex beside a river, with round corner towers, a central multi‑storey block, and a tall stair-tower. In the foreground, a paddle steamer and a smaller boat travel along the river. At the right, a metal truss bridge crosses the river in front of the castle. Trees and a riverside embankment line the shore. Printed German captions at the top read the name of the castle and the town on the Elbe River.
